How do I get started?

Select “Submit a sample” and enter your project details. In this concept preview, the request is saved on your device so you can explore the workflow.

How do I verify a certificate of analysis?

Enter the report reference in the COA lookup above. Use AN-2026-0042 to try the demonstration. The sample certificate contains fictional data and is not a valid laboratory report.

What should I send to the laboratory?

Sample quantity, packaging, shipping conditions, and documentation depend on the requested analysis. These requirements should be confirmed with the laboratory before shipping.

Where can I see pricing and turnaround?

These will be provided once the laboratory’s service catalog and operating details are finalized. This prototype does not quote or collect payments.
